topic: Fair Prosecution and Anti Selective Enforcement Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 14, Article 21
findings.limitations: Article 14 prohibits discriminatory or selective criminal enforcement based on political or personal vendetta as held in S.G. Jaisinghani v. Union of India AIR 1967 SC 1427.

gaps: Absence of statutory anti-vendetta comparator audits and independent pre-arrest judicial scrutiny for non-violent offenses.
